architectural_units.name: Security Service
architectural_units.description: Security Service (Traefik) functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing.

architectural_units.name: Traefik
architectural_units.description: Traefik is a modern reverse proxy and load balancer designed to manage incoming and outgoing HTTP and HTTPS traffic in container-based applications.

architectural_units.name: System Service
architectural_units.description: System Service (Next.js) serves the web application using React and communicates with the database service.

architectural_units.name: Next.js
architectural_units.description: Next.js is a framework for building web applications that supports both client-side and server-side rendering.

architectural_units.name: React
architectural_units.description: React is an open-source JavaScript library designed for building user interfaces efficiently and flexibly.

architectural_units.name: Data Service
architectural_units.description: Data Service (PostgreSQL) provides the relational database for storing application data.

architectural_units.name: PostgreSQL
architectural_units.description: PostgreSQL is the relational database management system used to store application data.

architectural_units.name: Prisma
architectural_units.description: Prisma is an ORM tool used to simplify database access and management in Node.js and TypeScript applications.

architectural_units.name: Docker
architectural_units.description: Docker is a containerization platform used to manage the execution of the application services.

architectural_units.name: Amazon EC2
architectural_units.description: Amazon EC2 is the cloud infrastructure where the application services are executed.

architectural_units.name: Cloud Storage Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for storing and retrieving files.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Amazon S3 is used for cloud storage to manage files.

architectural_units.name: Payment Processing Service
architectural_units.description: External service integrated to handle payments and subscriptions.

architectural_units.name: Stripe
architectural_units.description: Stripe is used to integrate payment processing functionalities.

architectural_units.name: Email Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for creating, sending, and scheduling emails.

architectural_units.name: Brevo
architectural_units.description: Brevo is used for email communication and marketing automation.

architectural_units.name: Monitoring Service
architectural_units.description: External service used to track and manage errors in the application.

architectural_units.name: Sentry
architectural_units.description: Sentry is used to track and manage errors in the application.

Security Service (Traefik) functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing. [...] Gestiona el enrutamiento de solicitudes HTTP y HTTPS hacia la aplicación Next.js (System Service).
System Service (Next.js) [...] Se comunica con el servicio de base de datos PostgreSQL (Data Service) utilizando Prisma como ORM.

System Service (Next.js) [...] Interactúa con varios servicios externos para funcionalidades específicas: [...] Almacenamiento en la nube: Utiliza Amazon S3 para almacenar y recuperar archivos. [...] Procesamiento de pagos: Integra con Stripe para manejar pagos y suscripciones. [...] Correo Electrónico: Se conecta a Brevo para crear, enviar y programar correos electrónicos. [...] Monitoreo de errores: Utiliza Sentry para rastrear y gestionar errores en la aplicación.
Data Service (PostgreSQL) [...] Se comunica directamente con Prisma para gestionar las consultas de la base de datos.

patterns.name: Observer Pattern
patterns.description: The Observer pattern establishes a one-to-many relationship between objects, where a subject maintains a list of observers and notifies them of state changes.

patterns.name: Singleton Pattern
patterns.description: The Singleton pattern ensures that a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to that instance.
